content.comment_body: How do I connect a 2-wire transmitter to the module?

Hello [user_name], welcome to the forum. This is an English-speaking forum, so please write future posts in English. Thank you. To connect the 2-wire transmitter, link the positive terminal of the 24 VDC power supply from the analog module to the positive terminal of the transmitter. Then, connect the negative terminal of the transmitter to the current input on the analog module. Refer to the attached diagram for clarification.
